title: A Spy Plane Flew New York to London in 1 Hour 54 Minutes

scenes.text: One plane flew from New York to London in under two hours.
In 1974, the SR-71 Blackbird made the trip in one hour, fifty-four minutes.
That's an average speed of over eighteen hundred miles an hour.
It cruised at about eighty-five thousand feet, more than twice as high as an airliner.
And in its whole career, not one was ever shot down.
Under two hours, New York to London.

description:
In 1974, the SR-71 Blackbird flew from New York to London in 1 hour, 54 minutes and 56 seconds, averaging over 1,800 miles an hour.
No SR-71 was ever shot down.
Would you ride it?
first_comment: Bonus: the record flight needed one mid-air refuel. Would you want to fly at 1,800 miles an hour?
